player_0.content: New plan: I misinterpreted the goal "Make the strood aphistic, the aciong dolam and the swaiced ailly" as requiring me to apply all three actions (mingne, eriat, ovesis) to every object I encountered. I repeatedly applied the same sequence of actions to the "aciong" without realizing that the "swaiced" object was missing from my initial perception list. I should have first identified the specific object corresponding to "swaiced" (likely the "perent" or "eucty" based on phonetic similarity) before attempting to modify the "aciong". My new strategy is to: 1) Re-read the initial perception to find the object that sounds like "swaiced" (probably "perent" or "eucty"). 2) Apply the correct transformation sequence (mingne -> eriat -> ovesis) only to the "strood" and the identified "swaiced" object. 3. Leave the "aciong" alone if it is not part of the goal, or only apply the specific actions required for it if the goal text implies a different set of targets. 4. Once all three targets are modified correctly, issue "> done".
